verdict.rationale: Stripe Issuing supports single-use virtual cards scoped to a task/session that auto-invalidate after use, plus per-authorization spending controls (exact amount, merchant category, merchant ID, single presence) to tightly scope a card to one purchase/merchant. missing for 10: no independent/hands-on corroboration of single-use card behavior beyond docs, and no explicit example combining exact-amount + single-merchant lock in one workflow.
